sources.title: CNN–LSTM Hybrid for Doppler Radar Nowcasting A Lightweight Framework ...
sources.snippet: An original model is introduced in this research that uses the combination of CNN and LSTM for local Doppler radar nowcasting. At first, convolutional layers examine radar data to find features such as reflectivity cores and the edges of storms.

sources.title: TITAN‐LSTM: A Weather Radar Nowcasting Tool - Viteri López - 2026 ...
sources.snippet: To bridge this gap, we have introduced TITAN-LSTM, a hybrid radar nowcasting algorithm that combines TITAN with a Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) network. TITAN identifies and tracks rainstorm life histories and predicts their displacements, while LSTM forecasts rain area and precipitation intensity based on TITAN tracking.
